facts.fact: Senegal Numerique SA (SENUM) states the Diamniadio National Datacenter, a hosting and storage facility that also reserves a technical room for SMEs, start-ups and the private sector, was inaugurated by President Macky Sall on 22 June 2021.
SENUM, the operator, states the Diamniadio National Datacenter is the first national Tier 3 datacenter (operator statement, no Uptime Institute certification cited); inaugurated 22 June 2021.
